budget.rationale: Five category rollups total $12,300–$15,550, consistent with the rounded $12,300–$15,500 band. The whole band is above target and the high case exceeds the preferred maximum; flight prices remain gated proxies.

weather.rationale: Funchal official June normals are about 65–75°F with little rain; coastal Sicily is warm/dry but the Sicily grid-cell range was not independently regenerated in this audit.

swim.rationale: Sicily schedules repeated Cefalù, Mondello, Isola Bella, and Giardini Naxos swimming. The 72–75°F range was not independently re-extracted from OISST; if verified, it would align more naturally with the rubric's 4/5 band.

variety.rationale: Four lodging sleeps strongly cover Madeira hiking, Sicilian beaches, Palermo/Cefalù culture and food, and Etna nature.

ease.rationale: Four lodging sleeps, three base moves, two rental cars, two internal flights, and up to three connections are high load. However, the unprotected-ticket uncertainty belongs in Risk, so the deterministic rubric more plausibly supports 2/5 than 1/5.

food.rationale: Current operator evidence independently covers groceries in Funchal/Lisbon and Cefalù plus plain pizza/fries in Taormina and delivery/takeaway pizza in Giardini Naxos. Combined with Sicily/Madeira food appeal, this strongly supports 5/5; recheck each business for 2027.

risk.rationale: Verified 2026-07-19: the Tuesday easyJet LIS-PMO nonstop is selling in the current pattern and same-day one-stop backups (Vueling via BCN, TAP+ITA via FCO) are sold daily, so the no-same-day-recovery assumption behind 1/5 no longer holds. Madeira wind plus a separate-ticket, less-than-daily nonstop still cap this at 2/5 until June 2027 loads.

nights.rationale: Twelve hotel nights derive 5/5 under the canonical nights rubric.

novelty.rationale: Madeira and Sicily's planned regions do not repeat exact places in the documented visited list; 5/5 derives under the current rubric.

pto.rationale: Eight PTO days derive 3/5 under the slider rubric and have zero default weight.
